copy.section_title: Room Signage & Door Display Project References
copy.section_subtitle: Reference formats for hotel room identification, doorbell, service status, and guest-facing display planning.
copy.intro_text: Review representative hospitality room-signage formats across dark glass, brushed silver, and brushed aluminum finishes. These images illustrate project-style layouts and visible interface treatments for discussion; they are not standardized product models or customer endorsements.
copy.cta_primary: Discuss Your Hotel Room Display Requirements
copy.disclaimer_text: Images are project-style references for hotel room signage and door display configurations. Visible room numbers, hotel names, interface labels, and other project-style details are shown only to illustrate application context and configuration form. They do not indicate public endorsement, a fixed SKU, stock availability, or a standardized product model. Actual appearance, text, icons, functions, materials, dimensions, networking method, MOQ, lead time, compatibility, and production scope must be confirmed for each project and quotation.

risk_assessment.handling: Treat them as visual context only and never repeat specific numbers in public text or metadata.
Use Project display reference labels and explicit wording that visible identities do not indicate endorsement or a customer relationship.

risk_assessment.risk: Standard SKU or stock availability may be inferred
risk_assessment.handling: Do not create product links or SKU controls; keep project-confirmation language and the full disclaimer.
Use only selected front and angled views and publish no material, dimension, networking, compatibility, or certification specifications.
Use only the eight approved images and leave the ten rear, repetitive, or artifact-heavy images internal.

risk_assessment.risk: Eight large images may affect mobile performance
risk_assessment.handling: Optimize copies, use 16:9 stable frames, responsive sizes, and default lazy loading with no priority images.
Use next/image defaults and verify all eight images load during scroll testing.
Treat the Project display reference card label and full disclaimer as mandatory module content.

implementation_validation_plan: Confirm exactly eight optimized public images and unique public paths.
Confirm all four approved display groups have two cards.
Confirm no public filename, ALT text, title, caption, or metadata includes a visible brand, customer name, or specific room number.
Confirm the module appears only on /en/solutions/hotel-guest-room-control-solution/.
Confirm it appears after Recommended Products and before Project planning details.
Confirm no new route or sitemap URL is created.
Confirm no Product, Offer, Review, Rating, or CaseStudy schema is added.
Confirm all images use /media/room-display-projects/ and no WordPress upload URL.
Confirm desktop and mobile layouts have no overflow, overlap, or broken images.
Confirm all eight images lazy load and the disclaimer and CTAs are visible.
Run lint, data tests, static export build, and focused output risk scans during the implementation stage.
